scoring_justification: The agent submits only final peak lists; the checker cannot recompute the DFT optical spectra or Eliashberg function from the provided artifacts, so result-level comparison against paper-reported values is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for optical peak energies and dominant phonon energy
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Optical peaks: paper Fig.1/Fig.3 reports transient spectral features at 2.6, 2.18, 1.95 eV. Dominant phonon energy: paper states a group of phonons with frequencies ~20 meV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from the paper text and figures. For phonon, the nominal value 20.0 meV is used.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact quantitative findings reported in the paper; no synthetic holdout is needed.

outputs.description: Three main peak energies (eV) extracted from the calculated optical spectrum after a 4% rigid red-shift of the energy axis.
Energy (meV) at which the Eliashberg spectral function α²F(ω) is maximum, corresponding to the phonon group around 20 meV.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each submitted peak energy against the paper-reported values with a tolerance of ±0.05 eV, and checks that the submitted phonon energy lies within the hidden range 18–22 meV. The scoring policies are exact_match with allowed deviation.
